propositions: Unconditional top-level imports of rebar_reconciler.git_adapter at _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194 break standalone by-path module execution where the package is intentionally absent.
The held-out interface test fails deterministically with ModuleNotFoundError when acquiring the preview lock in standalone context because __package__ is empty and find_spec returns None.
Both lock seams must use lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py") to converge with unchanged package-context importers on a single sys.modules key and restore standalone execution.
The repair preserves adapter API identity, lock semantics, packaging structure, and intentional wheel design while restoring pre-d9 behavior without test-only path pollution.
